caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur, rendered primarily in shades of gray and black, with clear attention to highlights and shadows to create a three-dimensional effect. The spur features two upward-curving arms at the top, each ending in a rectangular opening with three vertical bars. The neck of the spur is smoothly curved and connects to a large, round rowel (wheel) at the bottom, which has several long, sharply pointed, evenly spaced spikes radiating outward. The segment where the arms meet contains decorative ridges. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color with no additional objects or patterns. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner with the text "MAJEL G. CLAFLIN - TAOS - N.M."
title: Spur
